subtasks: Pick up the mallet and strike all xylophone keys from left to right.
The left hand holds the mallet on the sixth (blue) key. Lift it more than 2.5 cm, strike the seventh purple key, lift more than 2.5 cm, then strike the rightmost eighth key.
The strikes are finished. Carry the raised mallet left of the xylophone, set it gently on the clear table, release it, and return the left hand to its starting pose. Keep the right hand at rest.

The left hand holds the mallet. Play the last four keys starting with the fifth cyan key, then blue, purple, and rightmost magenta. Tap each key firmly and separately in the center, lifting the head at least 3 cm after each tap.
